experiment.title: Lab 19 L2: read-only GPU health queries and clock-event-reason interpretation

memory health: ECC [N/A], remapped rows corr/uncorr 0.0/0.0, pending No, failure No, recovery action None
PCIe: Gen4 x8 (device max Gen4 x8, host max Gen5), replays since reset 0

needs: a GPU with ECC-protected HBM/GDDR (data-centre SKU)
host kernel-log access (root on the host, not in an unprivileged container)
not_runnable_parts.part: Xid / AER lines in the kernel log (journalctl -k | grep -E 'NVRM: Xid|AER')
not_runnable_parts.probe: dmesg rc=1: dmesg: read kernel buffer failed: Operation not permitted; journalctl present: False

needs: bare-metal Linux with pciutils and root
not_runnable_parts.probe: lspci rc=0; /sys/bus/pci/devices = ['5582:00:00.0', '61e4:00:00.0', '6294:00:00.0', 'a1c2:00:00.0'] (WSL2 exposes virtual PCI, not the GPU's BDF)

needs: DCGM host engine on a data-centre GPU
RDMA HCAs, rdma-core, LLDP neighbours on the backend switches
not_runnable_parts.part: rank_map NIC columns (hca, hca_bdf, rail, leaf, leaf_port, backend_ip)
not_runnable_parts.probe: /sys/class/infiniband present: False; ibdev2netdev: False; lldpctl: False

needs: 2+ RDMA nodes in a dedicated partition and an authorised port to disable
not_runnable_parts.part: L3 link-flap trials (3 s / 8 s / 15 s) vs NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT x NCCL_IB_RETRY_CNT

needs: a server platform with ECC DIMMs and the EDAC driver

notes: All health queries are read-only: nothing is reset, reconfigured, or written to the device.
Clock-event reasons sampled every 200 ms (nvidia-smi -lms); per-reason counters read before and after each phase.

phases.interpretation: idle: clocks parked, nothing to run

phases.action: none: normal under full load (judge the sustained clock against peers)
phases.interpretation: power-limited at the enforced limit: the normal state of a GPU working flat out

phases.action: none: compare against peers' sustained clock
phases.interpretation: busy below max boost with no reason asserted: the voltage/frequency curve, not throttling
idle: clocks parked, nothing to run

tables.topo_m:
GPU0	CPU Affinity	NUMA Affinity	GPU NUMA ID
GPU0	 X 				N/A

Legend:

  X    = Self
  SYS  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes (e.g., QPI/UPI)
  NODE = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the interconnect between PCIe Host Bridges within a NUMA node
  PHB  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as a PCIe Host Bridge (typically the CPU)
  PXB  = Connection traversing multiple PCIe bridges (without traversing the PCIe Host Bridge)
  PIX  = Connection traversing at most a single PCIe bridge
  NV#  = Connection traversing a bonded set of # NVLinks
